title: A failed cloud run's page tells the person to resume it locally
description:
stopsFromStatusDoc hardcodes clear_with `ticfac run-epic <epic>` for the failed-phase stop, and notifyRunEnded feeds it a doc with host "cloud" straight from the Run Workflow's finalize. So the page a person receives for a failed cloud run names the LOCAL foreground resume — exactly the move ResumeCommand (tick gtk) exists to prevent: run-epic on the reader's machine restarts the epic locally instead of resubmitting to the factory (`ticfac run <epic> --cloud`). The Go model spells the resume by host; the TS stop builder ignores doc.host.
evidence: cloudflare/src/notify.ts:87 (clear_with) fed by the cloud doc at cloudflare/src/notify.ts:299-313; compare internal/statusmodel/commands.go ResumeCommand's cloud branch

ticfac run run_f44b6ad8909b495cbd3bae4ee7cf229c created this tick by absorbing the finding b4effa80fbc7f99e5113e4f70c6ce5804f3399134f9c0e9db7f2eecf1c2d07f8 (reported by run-run_f44b6ad8909b495cbd3bae4ee7cf229c/tick-q8m/attempt-1): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A2. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/run_f44b6ad8909b495cbd3bae4ee7cf229c/absorptions/b4effa80fbc7f99e5113e4f70c6ce5804f3399134f9c0e9db7f2eecf1c2d07f8.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-04 09:49 - ticfac run run_f44b6ad8909b495cbd3bae4ee7cf229c: created by absorbing finding b4effa80fbc7f99e5113e4f70c6ce5804f3399134f9c0e9db7f2eecf1c2d07f8 — placed before the final review, which is blocked-by tt6. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/run_f44b6ad8909b495cbd3bae4ee7cf229c/absorptions/b4effa80fbc7f99e5113e4f70c6ce5804f3399134f9c0e9db7f2eecf1c2d07f8.json on epic/hn6, and it says: the classifier put 0.51 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, at or above the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35, and named A2: a false positive costs the epic work it did not need, a false negative closes an epic whose goal is unmet in a factory where nobody is watching, and those are not the same cost — the threshold sits on the cheap side
